name: AG3C REL606 same-culture mRNA + protein (+ flux)
ribosome_profiling: none — no Ribo-seq exists for this culture series
other_layers: D05 metabolic flux ratios (13C GC-MS), grown separately
conditions: 57 conditions (carbon source x Mg2+ x Na+ x growth phase x harvest time) plus a 9-point glucose starvation time course
paired_bio_n: 25 conditions with 3 complete mRNA+protein cultures, 2 with 4, 7 with 2, 5 with 1, 18 with 0 (computed from Supplementary Dataset 1); 102 cultures carry both layers in the published matrices, 109 culture ids appear in both the GEO series and the PRIDE deposits
matching_class: 1 (same biological culture, split aliquots) for mRNA vs protein; 3 for flux (separate cultures in 13C glucose)
observed_differences: flux cultures differ by design; the glucose time course appears in two deposits (GSE67402 with AG3C-NN ids and inside GSE94117 with MURI_0NN ids)
unknowns: pH, aeration rate and OD at harvest are not reported; the 7-culture gap between the archive-id intersection (109) and the published matrix (102) is not explained in the text read
recommendation: Take as the primary matched bundle for anything that needs real replication across two layers. Do not use it as an MG1655 resource without an explicit REL606->MG1655 crosswalk and a cross-strain claim; the matrices are keyed by ECB_ locus tags and YP_ protein accessions.

name: NCM3722 translation bundle (Hwa/Dai lineage)
conditions: 12 chemostat/batch conditions at 0.1 and 0.6 /h (C, N, P, leucine limitation; minimal and defined rich) for D06/D07; growth-limitation titration series for D11
paired_bio_n: 3 per condition for Ribo-seq and 3 for RNA-seq in all 12 conditions; 0 complete three-layer cultures, because the proteome comes from a different study
matching_class: 2 between D06 and D07 (same study, same conditions, aligned replicate indices, culture identity not stated); 3 between those and D11 (different study, same strain background, overlapping but not identical limitation series)
observed_differences: D11 titrates glucose uptake and ammonia assimilation in batch; D06/D07 use chemostat dilution rates. Media families agree (MOPS-based minimal glucose) but concentrations and culture mode differ
unknowns: whether the RNA-seq and Ribo-seq libraries in D06/D07 come from the same culture; temperature is not reported in the retrieved D06/D07 methods
recommendation: Best available route to all three core layers in one strain background with n=3 on two of them. Cross-strain to the viewer (NCM3722, not MG1655), so the same crosswalk/claim caveat as B1 applies.

name: MG1655 MOPS-glucose three-layer, cross-study
transcriptomics: GAP — no MG1655 MOPS minimal glucose RNA-seq found; D09 covers MOPS rich only, n=1
proteomics: D11 EQ353 calibration samples (MOPS minimal glucose, 3 cultures, 7 MS runs)
conditions: MOPS minimal glucose, exponential growth (growth rates 0.69-0.73 /h for the EQ353 cultures per the repository dossier)
paired_bio_n: 0 complete cross-layer cultures; per-layer n = 2 (Ribo-seq) and 3 (proteome)
matching_class: 3 (different studies, similar documented conditions) between D08 and D11; the transcriptomics slot is 4 (unknown) because no matching dataset was found
observed_differences: EQ353 is an MG1655 sub-strain from the Li 2014 lineage; the Ribo-seq tracks are pooled
unknowns: Li 2014 methods were not readable this session (non-OA), so harvesting, inhibitor use and culture counts behind the two minimal-medium libraries are not established
recommendation: Do not adopt as a bundle. INDEPENDENCE WARNING: Mori Dataset EV9 is scaled per protein to Li 2014 synthesis rates, so EV9 vs D08 is circular; use the unscaled EV6 values. The transcriptomics gap is the blocking problem.

name: MG1655 M9-glucose two-layer, cross-study
ribosome_profiling: GAP — no MG1655 Ribo-seq in M9 glucose found
conditions: M9 minimal glucose, 37 C, aerobic, exponential
paired_bio_n: 0 complete cross-layer cultures; per-layer n = 2 (proteome) and 2-6 per project group, 33 samples pooled across projects (transcriptome)
observed_differences: glucose concentration differs across PRECISE projects (2 g/L vs 4 g/L); the Zhao proteome reports no temperature and no glucose concentration in the record read
unknowns: harvest OD for the PRECISE samples; Zhao replicate identities
recommendation: Usable as a two-layer reference point on the viewer's own strain and namespace (b-numbers both sides). Weak replication on the protein side; no translation layer.

name: BW25113 condition-breadth proteome with compendium transcriptome
conditions: 22 proteome conditions vs the compendium's BW25113 conditions
paired_bio_n: 0 complete cross-layer cultures; proteome n=3 per condition (paper statement), transcriptome mostly n=2 per project condition
matching_class: 3 to 4 — condition correspondence between the two was not established this session
observed_differences: not characterised: the 22 Schmidt condition recipes were not retrieved this session
unknowns: which PRECISE BW25113 conditions correspond to which Schmidt conditions
recommendation: Highest condition breadth for absolute protein abundance, but the pairing work is unfinished. Retrieve Schmidt Table S1/S6 and align condition by condition before relying on it.

name: Per-layer fallback (no bundle)
proteomics: D10 Schmidt 2016 (absolute copies per cell, 22 conditions, triplicate)
observed_differences: three different strains (MG1655, BW25113, NCM3722), three different media families
recommendation: Use when a layer is needed independently and no cross-layer inference is made. This is the recommended fallback if B1's strain is unacceptable.
